Tidy the trajectories from a particle filter

Source: R/simulation.R
tidy_filter.Rd

Convert the trajectories held by a filter or unfilter after dust2::dust_likelihood_run() into a long-format tibble. Times and group names are read from the filter.

Usage

tidy_filter(
  obj,
  select_random_particle = FALSE,
  index_state = NULL,
  vars = NULL,
  dims = NULL,
  labels = NULL
)

Arguments

obj

A dust_likelihood object, created by dust2::dust_filter_create() or dust2::dust_unfilter_create(), that has been run with save_trajectories = TRUE.

select_random_particle

Logical, passed to dust2::dust_likelihood_last_trajectories(): return a single randomly selected particle rather than all of them.

index_state

The index_state passed to dust2::dust_likelihood_run(), if any.

vars

Optional character vector of variables to keep, for example c("I", "incidence"). Selecting variables before reshaping is much cheaper than filtering afterwards.

dims

Optional names for the dimensions of array variables. Either an unnamed character vector applied by position to every array variable (c("age", "vax")), or a named list giving the dimension names of each variable (list(S = c("age", "vax"), R = "age")). Dimensions that are not named produce columns index1, index2, and so on.

labels

Optional named list of labels for dimensions, for example list(age = c("child", "adult")). Labelled dimensions become factors. Use the name group to label parameter groups.

Value

A tibble with columns group and particle (where present), time, variable, one column per array dimension and value. Times are the times of the data.
